major_cooldowns.name: Takedown
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it with at least 2 Tip of the Spear stacks up and line it up with your potion, on-use trinket, and racials, since its 20% damage buff and doubled attack speed only last 8 seconds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table shows a self aura on the same id alongside the cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Boomstick
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown with a Tip of the Spear stack up, and prefer it on a target that has not yet been hit by Sentinel's Mark.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table shows a self aura on the same id alongside the cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Moonlight Chakram
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: This is Takedown's button once the Sentinel hero tree is chosen; cast it early inside the Takedown window rather than saving it for the end, since it takes a long time to land, and dump your Wildfire Bomb charges first if Stalk and Strike is talented.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 1264949 seen once in the sampled parses; the guide's id 1264902 was not found in the table. It replaces Takedown so it shares Takedown's 90s cooldown rather than having one of its own.

rule.description: Open with pre-pull Bomb, Kill Command, Takedown, Boomstick
rule.action: Throw Wildfire Bomb about a second before the pull, open with Kill Command, send Takedown alongside your potion and trinket, then follow up with Boomstick.

rule.description: Boomstick only with Tip of the Spear up
rule.action: Wait for Kill Command to grant Tip of the Spear before you press Boomstick so it gets the damage buff.

rule.description: Spend every Tip of the Spear stack before it expires
rule.action: Follow every Kill Command with two Tipped abilities from your priority list before it falls off.

rule.description: Don't recast Kill Command while Tip of the Spear is capped
rule.action: Only recast Kill Command once your Tip of the Spear stacks have dropped, not while you are still capped.

rule.description: Cast Takedown only with 2 Tip of the Spear stacks
rule.action: Build a full Tip of the Spear stack with Kill Command before you press Takedown, since its pet hit lands a second late and needs the buff already up.
